answer_4.guideline: Defining R as the set of verses in which BP hits occur and B as the set of verses in which 'bird' occurs, we use four evaluation categories. (1) one-to-one. R ≈ B. In detail: |R -B| < .1|B| and R -B does not contain plausible additional hits. (2) polysemy. R ⊃ B and R -B consists of verses with concepts closely related to 'bird', e.g., 'dove', 'fly'. (3) ambiguity. R -B contains verses in which neither 'bird' nor closely related meanings occur. However, there is a second "non-bird" meaning of the BP hits; e.g., for Adioukrou the FP hit is "Or" and the BP hits correspond to two clusters, a bird cluster and a hitting cluster. (4) failure. R -B or B -R is large and this cannot be attributed to polysemy or (simple) ambiguity.
